title: Policy-result record
description: Policy-result record (Novera Protocol Specification v0.1, pre-production). Records the result of evaluating one version of one policy against stated subjects, inputs and scope. v0.1 models results only; it does not define an autonomous compliance engine. A result is evidence of an evaluation, not a legal determination, legal advice or a regulatory approval.

policyResultId.description: Opaque policy-result identifier. Results are immutable; a re-evaluation creates a new result.

resultAuthority.description: States that the record is an evaluation result, not a legal or regulatory determination.

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the policy definition evaluated.

policyDigest.description: Digest of the policy definition evaluated, so the evaluated logic can be identified exactly.

subjectRefs.description: Records the policy was evaluated against.

result.description: Overall result: pass, fail, indeterminate (inputs insufficient to decide), not_applicable (the policy does not apply to the subjects in scope), requires_review (a human or provider decision is required).

conditions.description: Results for individual conditions within the policy, where the policy is composed of conditions.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence relied on by the evaluation.

inputStateRefs.description: Record versions the evaluation read. A result applies only to these versions.

inputsDigest.description: Digest of the complete canonical evaluation input, allowing the evaluation to be reproduced.

evaluationMethod.description: How the result was produced: deterministic_rules (versioned rule logic), external_provider (output of an external provider), human_review (decision of an authorized person), hybrid (a combination, described by conditions). Jurisdiction-specific logic is expressed through the policy identity and scope.jurisdiction.

evaluatedBy.description: Actor that produced the result. An assistive system MUST NOT be the evaluator of record.

validUntil.description: When the result lapses and MUST be re-evaluated before reliance.

scope.description: Context within which the result applies. A result MUST NOT be relied on outside its scope.

supersedes.description: Earlier result for the same policy and scope that this result replaces.

conditionResult.description: Result for one condition of the policy.

conditionId.description: Condition identifier, unique within the policy version.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence relied on for the condition.
